title: RepoAssure AI IDE Repair Handoff MCP Tool Implementation v0.1
objective: Use TDD and the test pyramid to implement only the additive prepare_repair_handoff MCP tool by reusing the package-owned handoff runner, preserving exact schema, annotations, redaction, fail-closed errors, maintainer review, verification-plan, and no-target-write boundaries from ADR-0024.
acceptance: Preserve all eight existing MCP tools unchanged and add only prepare_repair_handoff.
Reuse the package-owned repair handoff runner without duplicating domain logic.
Implement the exact runDir and optional outputDir input contract plus bounded structured output.
Declare readOnlyHint false, destructiveHint false, idempotentHint false, and openWorldHint false.
Fail closed and redact both text and structured errors before any invalid-input artifact write.
Prove real MCP tools/list and tools/call behavior, package installation compatibility, and no target repository writes.
Keep validation-only command execution, automatic patch application, resources, prompts, and the other three candidate tools outside this Goal.
